descByPlatform.chatgpt: science fair project poster for a middle-school volcano experiment display, 2:3 vertical trifold-board layout flattened. Subject: colourful trifold board with centre panel hero showing a cross-section volcano diagram with magma chamber, conduit and erupting cone; left panel 'HYPOTHESIS' text block plus labelled photograph of baking-soda-vinegar model; right panel 'RESULTS' bar chart of eruption heights across 5 trials and a small data table. Typography: 'Volcanic Eruptions' Helvetica Neue 64pt bold in science blue #005F73 centred at 50% x 8% y; all body copy Inter 14pt regular in science blue; chart labels chart yellow #E9C46A. Composition: Rule of Thirds on volcano cone, Centered 50% x 54% y, Eye-Level 0° flat overhead, board 92% frame, hero vertical. Camera: 35mm f/5.6 1/125s ISO 200 overhead copy-stand. Lighting: flat even copy-stand lighting — twin 4×4ft softboxes overhead-left and overhead-right 45° 1.5m balanced (key + fill), no rim, 4×4ft white floor bounce reduce shadow. Material physics: foam-board micro-tooth, glossy photo print specular, marker ink bleed edges, grain-6. Palette: science blue #005F73 30%, flame orange #EE6C4D 25%, lab cream #EDF6F9 20%, leaf green #2A9D8F 15%, chart yellow #E9C46A 10%. References: Scholastic fair archive, Edward Tufte diagrams, classic schoolbook infographics. Exclude: cluttered, unreadable, dull, low-contrast, amateurish.
